sections.title: Targeting Filters
items: Team filter mode: None, Same Team, Whitelist, or Blacklist.
Dynamic team selection dropdowns — automatically scans the Teams service.
Player whitelist/blacklist with multi‑select dropdowns — scanned live from the server.
Name & DisplayName pattern filtering.
Filters re‑evaluate instantly when lists change — no restart needed.

sections.title: Appearance
items: Chams enabled toggle with Always On Top option.
Fill and outline color pickers with transparency sliders (Gen1) or alpha support (Gen2).

sections.title: Performance
items: Hooks now skip over non-limb instances completely, so they don't do extra work on every single object.
Proximity shrinking spreads its work across multiple frames now — way better FPS when a ton of players are around.
Pre-calculated distance thresholds for each limb, so the shrink logic has to do a lot less math every update.
Swapped a slow `.Magnitude` check for a quick squared distance comparison.

sections.title: Dynamic Scale
items: Changing the shrink range multiplier now instantly updates all active limbs without needing a restart.
Limbs way out of range won't keep getting set to their base size if they're already there.

sections.title: Cosmetic & Behavior
items: Cosmetic update loop now bails early if a restart is pending, so it doesn't waste time re-applying stuff that's about to be redone.

sections.title: Security
items: Rewrote limb property hooks to eliminate environment leaks.
Added upvalue obfuscation for executor environments where direct metatable hooks are used.
Solara executor users now have significantly lower detection.

sections.title: Bypass Engine
items: Auto-detection of hookmetamethod vs raw metatable hooking — uses the best available method.
New proxy-based table hiding when raw metatable path is active (renders internal tables invisible to AC scanners).

sections.title: Miscellaneous
items: Removed leftover debugging function `getTargetData` that was causing a stack-level signature.
Unified bypass logic into a single, conditionally compiled block; no more BYPASS_AVAILABLE flag checks at runtime.

sections.title: UI Bug Fixes
items: Fixed ESP Level of Detail (LOD) toggles not updating correctly.

sections.title: UI Switching
items: Added a button to switch between Gen1 and Gen2 UI on the fly.
UI preference is saved and persists across restarts.

sections.title: Configuration
items: Merged LastSeenVersion and UIVersion into a single AXIOS_Config.json file.

sections.title: New Feature
items: Proximity shrinking for limbs to get smaller when you get close.

sections.title: UI Changes
items: Migrated to Rayfield-Gen2, from Rayfield-2022.
Reorganized options and settings to better reflect their functions and names.
